# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

# Packages

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
```

# Data Loading & Cleaning


```{r load-data}

FILE_PATH = "data/full_data.csv"
raw <- read_tsv(FILE_PATH, locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-16LE"),  show_col_types = FALSE)

# Inspect
glimpse(raw)
```

```{r clean-data}
df <- raw %>%
  # keep only finished participants
  filter(FINISHED == 1) %>%
  filter(TIME_SUM >= 300) %>%
  # drop admin / test entries
  filter(MODE != "admin", prolific_id != "test", FINISHED == 1, STATUS == "complete") %>%
  mutate(
    age             = as.numeric(age),
    gender          = factor(gender, levels = 1:2, labels = c("male", "female")),
    model_condition = factor(model_condition,
                             levels = 1:3,
                             labels = c("unprompted", "sycophantic", "contrarian")),
    topic  = factor(topic)
  )

cat("N after exclusions:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

```{r attitude-scoring}
# Helper: row-wise mean ignoring NA
row_mean <- function(df, cols) {
  rowMeans(df[, cols], na.rm = TRUE)
}


topics <- c("space", "quota", "taxes", "animals", "speech")

# build composite pre-post opinion and confidence measures & experience composites via means
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Pre Opinion
    opinion_pre = case_when(
      topic == "space"   ~ space_02,
      topic == "quota"   ~ pre_quota,
      topic == "taxes"   ~ pre_taxes,
      topic == "animals" ~ pre_animals,
      topic == "speech"  ~ pre_speech
    ),
    # Post-opinion
    opinion_post = case_when(
      topic == "space"   ~ post_space_04,
      topic == "quota"   ~ post_quota,
      topic == "taxes"   ~ post_taxes,
      topic == "animals" ~ post_animals,
      topic == "speech"  ~ post_speech
    ),
    opinion_change = opinion_post - opinion_pre,
    confidence_change = post_confidence - pre_confidence,
    # Scale composites
    competence  = row_mean(., c("competence_01", "competence_02", "competence_03")),
    trust       = row_mean(., c("trust_01",       "trust_02",       "trust_03")),
    satisfaction = row_mean(., paste0("satisfaction_0", 1:5)),
    sycophancy  = row_mean(., c("sycophancy_01",  "sycophancy_02")),
    credibility = row_mean(., c("credibility_01", "credibility_02", "credibility_03")),
    continuance = row_mean(., c("continuance_01", "continuance_02"))
  )
```

# Sample Description

## Age

```{r sample-desc}
df %>%
  summarise(
    N        = n(),
    Age_M    = round(mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Age_SD   = round(sd(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Age_min  = min(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Age_max  = max(age, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = "Sample demographics") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped")
```

## Gender

```{r gender-table}
df %>%
  count(gender) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Gender distribution") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped")
```

## Model and Topic Conditions

```{r condition-table}
df %>%
  count(model_condition, topic) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = topic, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  kable(caption = "Participants per condition × topic") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped")
```
```{r condition-table}
df %>%

  kable(caption = "Participants per condition × topic") %>%

```

## Time Overview

```{r time-table}
df %>%
  summarise(
    N        = n(),
    Time_M    = round(round(mean(TIME_SUM, na.rm = TRUE), 1)/60, 1),
    Time_SD   = round(round(sd(TIME_SUM, na.rm = TRUE), 1)/60, 1),
    Time_min  = min(TIME_SUM, na.rm = TRUE)/60,
    Time_max  = max(TIME_SUM, na.rm = TRUE)/60
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = "Sample demographics") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped")
```

# Scale Reliability

```{r reliability}
alpha_table <- tibble(
  Scale = c("Competence", "Trust", "Satisfaction", "Sycophancy",
            "Credibility", "Continuance"),
  Items = c(3, 3, 5, 2, 3, 2),
  Alpha = c(
    alpha(df[, c("competence_01", "competence_02", "competence_03")])$total$raw_alpha,
    alpha(df[, c("trust_01", "trust_02", "trust_03")])$total$raw_alpha,
    alpha(df[, paste0("satisfaction_0", 1:5)])$total$raw_alpha,
    alpha(df[, c("sycophancy_01", "sycophancy_02")])$total$raw_alpha,
    alpha(df[, c("credibility_01", "credibility_02", "credibility_03")])$total$raw_alpha,
    alpha(df[, c("continuance_01", "continuance_02")])$total$raw_alpha
  )
) %>%
  mutate(Alpha = round(Alpha, 3))

alpha_table %>%
  kable(caption = "Cronbach's alpha for composite scales") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped")
```

# Descriptive Statistics by Condition

```{r descriptives}
df %>%
  group_by(model_condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n            = n(),
    opinion_pre_M    = round(mean(opinion_pre,    na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    opinion_pre_SD   = round(sd(opinion_pre,      na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    opinion_post_M   = round(mean(opinion_post,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    opinion_post_SD  = round(sd(opinion_post,     na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    opinion_change_M = round(mean(opinion_change, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    opinion_change_SD= round(sd(opinion_change,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    competence_M = round(mean(competence, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    trust_M      = round(mean(trust,      na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    satisfaction_M = round(mean(satisfaction, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sycophancy_M = round(mean(sycophancy, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    credibility_M = round(mean(credibility, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    continuance_M = round(mean(continuance, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  ) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  kable(caption = "Descriptive statistics by condition") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped")
```
